_note: Offline-only config. Freqtrade never talks to an exchange here: the bars come from tools/freqtrade_export.py (MT5) via tools/freqtrade_sync.py. 'kraken' is a data-directory namespace - it has no other role: kraken is the one supported exchange whose markets actually contain FX pairs like USD/JPY (freqtrade validates pair names against real markets even offline), and offline_mode keeps every API call out of the process. Spot mode is the honest limit of the pilot: freqtrade cannot short on spot, and every exchange it supports for futures/margin lacks FX pairs, so this engine scores the LONG side only - the research replays remain its authority for the short side. fee is 0 because freqtrade's kraken default (0.26% PER SIDE) is a crypto taker fee that does not exist on this MT5 account: the real cost is the spread, which the research rules charge in R (cost_in_r) - so these numbers are pre-spread, pre-fee, and comparable to the research tables' own pre-cost figures.
_margin_note: margin mode reads spot candles; no funding/mark files are needed
